messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@quantix.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up + sizing call

Thanks for the discovery earlier today — this was really helpful. We're excited to keep moving. Per our discussion, the next step for us is a dedicated capacity sizing session (technical deep dive) to align on throughput and latency requirements and to validate costs.

Quick context on our side (attached I exported a small traffic snapshot):
- Peak concurrent users: ~120
- Average QPS: 18 sustained, short spikes to ~45 for bursts
- Average request size: 400 prompt tokens / 120 response tokens
- Target p99 latency: < 250ms for generation (open to trade-offs for batch/async flows)

Availability: next week (Dec 7–10) mornings PT generally work for our infra + LLM team. Can you propose 2 slots (one for a general sizing + one technical deep dive with SE)?

Thanks — looking forward.

— Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform

agomez@quantix.ai
(415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + sizing call

Hi Alicia — thanks for the snapshot and great context. Happy to set this up. Proposed plan:
1) 30–45m dedicated capacity sizing call (overview + numbers) — Marissa + Vivek from Redwood, Alicia + Quantix infra lead
2) Technical deep dive (SE-led) if the numbers look aligned — Vivek will bring modeling/latency detail and questions about KV cache, batching, and quantization tradeoffs.

Suggested slots (all PT):
- Tue Dec 8, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed Dec 9, 9:00–9:45am

Could you confirm which works or propose alternate windows? Also a couple of quick asks so Vivek can prep:
- Do you expect the 45 QPS bursts to be sustained across many minutes or short spikes (under 60s)?
- Are you planning to use a single model family (e.g., Llama2-70B) or a mix of smaller models for routing/fallback?
- Any network egress or private deployment constraints we should know about (VPC peering, on-prem requirements)?

I'll attach a preliminary capacity worksheet after we confirm a slot.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@quantix.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + sizing call

Thanks — looping in some initial SE notes so we can be efficient on the call. A few quick thoughts based on Alicia's snapshot:
- If bursts are < 60s, we can plan for burst capacity with short-term autoscaling and prefix/KV caching to reduce steady-state load.
- For 400/120 token average, estimation points to needing ~5–8 dedicated GPUs for low-latency (p99 < 250ms) on a single 70B model; mixing smaller model variants or quantized runtimes could reduce that by ~30–40% depending on quality targets.
- Network: VPC peering and a private endpoint will be simplest for low-latency secure traffic; if you need on-prem, that affects lead time and deployment packaging.

I've attached a quick working estimate (redwood_capacity_estimate_v1.xlsx) — it's a sketch, not final. Please flag anything that looks off; we'll refine live in the sizing call.

Also, Marissa — if you can lock a confirmed slot I'll send a calendar invite and a shared doc for workload details.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood_capacity_estimate_v1.xlsx

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@quantix.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + sizing call

Thanks both — Wed Dec 9, 9:00–9:45am PT works for our infra and ML leads. Please send the invite. A couple of final notes:
- The 45 QPS spikes are typically short (30–90s) tied to batch jobs and traffic surges; sustained is closer to the 18 QPS number.
- We'll plan to start with a single model family but may add a smaller fallback for cost optimization later.
- I'll upload our network/topology doc to the shared drive before the call.

One ask on compliance: our security team will want to see network requirements + SOC 2 references in advance. If you can share the network_requirements.pdf and a SOC 2 summary during the invite, that would speed approvals.

See you on Wed.

— Alicia
